note: Trigger-routing cases plus two known-answer exams, and the optimizer adapters' exam under known-answer/solver/ (run: uv run --with scipy --with z3-solver python known-answer/solver/exam.py). Routing cases are data-only, like the other skills' evals.json. The known-answer exams live under known-answer/ with ANSWER-KEY.md; run them by having a fresh agent follow SKILL.md on a git repo that holds only the fixture (never the key), telling it to write no telemetry record, then score its .claude/hypothesis/ output against the key. First run: 2026-10-24.

evals.prompt: 這個簽核模組不能出錯，幫我寫成假說
evals.expected_behavior: Code input; confirms rules, models with TLA+, shows seen failing and seen succeeding, has the never-happens list refuted by a fresh agent (seen faithful), publishes, shows the diagram series in the conversation as plain text.
Two-source comparison; roles read from the wording (SD behaviour, SA rules) and stated in the first line.

evals.prompt: 幫我看這份需求訪談紀錄有沒有矛盾
evals.expected_behavior: Document input; contradictions, gaps and ambiguities, each quoting its passage; ambiguities stay questions.

evals.prompt: 撤回和核准同時按下去偶爾還是會付款，先幫我建立假說
evals.expected_behavior: Symptom input (H1); paths handed back as probes; a pass never discards a clue.

evals.prompt: 按鈕的顏色太淡了，幫我改深一點
evals.expected_behavior: Look and copy are a not-trigger; no hypothesis.

evals.prompt: 程式一直報錯，幫我查一下
evals.expected_behavior: A plain error with no ordering signal routes to /hunt, not /hypothesis.

evals.prompt: 實際把 app 跑起來，證明這個修好了
evals.expected_behavior: Proving on the running app is /prove-it; it may read a hypothesis but does not write one.

evals.prompt: 這次重構把鎖的寫法收成一個模組，重構前後一樣嗎？
evals.expected_behavior: Code against its past commit: the old files copied to sources/<sha>/ with no sync.originals; two blind models under model/<role>/, compared on what a user observes in both directions at small bounds; every difference traced to the source before equal behaviour is claimed; a new-only platform listed in left_out.

evals.prompt: 哪幾步一定要放在鎖裡面，鎖才最短又不會遺失更新？找出最便宜的正確設計
evals.expected_behavior: Design search per references/design.md: holes and design-space constraints, the solver exam run first, a capped counterexample loop with the monotone cut only after its brute-force check, the optimum with LP bound, dual and gap reported, the chosen design published as an ordinary hypothesis.
